Akshay Sir's patient demeanor, attention to detail, and ability to inspire students of all levels make every class both challenging and deeply rewarding. I wholeheartedly recommend my guru Shri Akshay Ayre to anyone looking to immerse themselves in the beauty of Bharatnatyam.
